Name: Stardew Hero Trophy Overhaul
Author: coldazrael
Description:
Blue Trophy Base? Did joja made the Stardew Hero Trophy?
With this mod, no.

This mod overhauls the Stardew Hero Trophy, from changing it's base colours from joja blue to fancy wooden brown and flattening it a bit, removing the iridium star plaque and replacing with a simpler plaque, also overhauls the trophy symbol to 4 different variations!

For the 'Glorious' trophy, I took the inspiration from the cup shape of English Premier League trophy.
Next the 'Rising Star' trophy, I took the inspiration from some common trophy design.
Then the 'Town Icon' trophy, I personally draw it after googling some random pelican.
Last the 'Tree Bundle' trophy, I took base shape of Junimo Golden Scroll to match it.

[b]Installation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the Mod,
[*]Drop the Mod folder to Mods folder.
[/list]
[b]Config Options :
[/b]Unless you wanted the default gold glorious trophy, then ignore this part. Start by opening the config.json file with text editor (I personally prefer Notepad++).[list]
[*][i]EnableMod[/i] 
Master config to turn on and turn off the mod, the values are "true" or "false". The default is "true".[*][i]TrophyToggle[/i]
Config for the trophy symbol, the values are "Glorious", "RisingStar", "TownIcon" and "TreeBundle". The default is "Glorious".[*][i]MaterialToggle[/i]
Config for the material of trophy symbol, the values are "gold", "iridium" and "platinum". The default is "gold".[/list]

Downloads.Description: Drop the folder to Stardew Valley/Mods/
